summary: Telecom Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the Argentine Antitrust Tribunal's conditional approval of its acquisition of exclusive control over Telefónica Móviles Argentina S.A. and its subsidiaries. The resolution imposes structural remedies requiring transfer of 6,000,000 mobile customers (4M in AMBA, 2M rest of country) and spectrum rights, plus 211,400 residential internet subscribers in 28 localities, along with behavioral remedies in corporate and wholesale segments. The transaction was first disclosed on April 30, 2026. The antitrust conditionality creates an unusual risk-arb angle: investors must assess the feasibility and buyer identification for the mandated divestitures.
